R381.note: ProcessBuilder(cmd) drops the attacker-controlled envp array entirely and inherits a clean environment; command, output capture, and exception handling are unchanged.

R382.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync parameterizes accountId, status, and beforeUtc; still returns the row count and preserves the archival criteria per the stated contract.

R383.note: Implements allowlist-then-interpolate rather than a literal map lookup (contradicting the doctrine the write-up itself quotes), but with only 3 fixed literals able to pass the check the injection vector is fully closed; default table and bound values preserved.

R384.note: self.get_object() applies get_queryset() scoping plus check_object_permissions(), the standard DRF fix for this bypass; response shape and owner/staff behavior unchanged.

R385.note: @PreAuthorize is silently a no-op without @EnableMethodSecurity somewhere in the app, and no such config exists in the case files or is added by the fix, so enforcement is unverified; if it is active, 403 for both missing and unowned docs and unchanged 204 for owners matches the contract.

R386.note: Removes the vulnerable second URLDecoder.decode() and replaces the string '..' check with canonical-path containment; single-decode behavior matches the container's own decoding, preserving legitimate downloads.

R387.note: Unix branch is properly closed with an array exec plus '--'; empirically verified (via cmd.exe on this Windows host) that the Windows branch remains exploitable because a value containing an embedded double-quote followed by '&' breaks out of Windows' CreateProcess argument quoting and cmd.exe executes the injected command despite the array form.

R388.note: Replaces Runtime.exec() entirely with Files.newDirectoryStream(), eliminating the OS command sink outright; matches the original snippet's no-op use of the process result.

R389.note: offset > capacity / length > capacity - offset check avoids underflow and correctly bounds writes at any offset; matches the stated contract exactly, rejecting only truly oversized writes.

R390.note: .RequireAuthorization() is the correct Minimal API fix, and the app already wires UseAuthorization()/AddAuthorization() so it is not a no-op; matches the sibling MVC controller's authentication-only model since no ownership check exists anywhere in the app to preserve.

R391.note: OdbcParameter binds the wildcarded search term via the single '?' placeholder; ODBC binds positionally so the parameter name is cosmetic; query semantics and return shape unchanged.

R392.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes tenantId and the wildcarded term separately, preserving the tenant filter, contains-match semantics, and empty-term behavior per the stated contract.

R393.note: Single-path-component check plus canonical-path containment closes traversal; toRealPath() failures are caught and mapped to the same 404 as a missing file, preserving prior behavior for legitimate lookups.
